sections.Highlights: THIS... is a 2015 Maserati GranTurismo Sport, finished in Bianco Pregiato with a black interior. This coupe's odometer displays about 7,100 miles. The attached Carfax history report lists no mileage inconsistencies in this Maserati's past. Factory equipment includes the MC Sport Line Package, leather upholstery, heated and power-adjustable front seats, an Alcantara headliner, a Bose sound system, and more as detailed below. The seller reports no modifications. Maserati's first-generation GranTurismo made its debut for 2008 with a muscular-looking exterior design that later influenced the rest of the firm's range, a powerful V8 with Ferrari roots, and a relatively spacious interior that offered four usable seats. Production ended in 2019. Power comes from a 4.7-liter V8, rated at 454 horsepower and 384 lb-ft of torque. Output is sent to the rear wheels via a 6-speed automatic transmission.
sections.Equipment: MC Sport Line Package (front and rear carbon fiber spoilers, carbon fiber mirror housings and door handles, 20-inch wheels, carbon fiber interior (including steering wheel rim, paddle shifters, instrument panel, dashboard, and door panels), MC Sport Line sill plates, stiffer springs, shock absorbers, and anti-roll bars) Leather upholstery Heated and power-adjustable front seats Trident logo stitched into the front headrests Alcantara headliner Dual-zone automatic climate control CD player Bose sound system Navigation system Front and rear parking sensors
